headline: A RAMageddon guide to back-to-school laptop shopping
summary: Laptop prices are soaring due to a RAM and storage shortage. Students face higher costs for essential back-to-school devices. The guide offers advice despite the current market challenges.

headline: Lamborghini’s flagship Revuelto levels up with SV trim
summary: Lamborghini introduces the Revuelto SV, an upgraded flagship model. The car aims for driver-vehicle unity, not distraction reduction. This new trim emphasizes an immersive driving experience.

headline: The X-Files creator Chris Carter wanted to make a more horrific movie
summary: Chris Carter originally envisioned a much more horrific 'X-Files' movie. The 2008 film 'I Want to Believe' deviated from his grisly supernatural plot. Studio executives at 20th Century Fox pushed for a different direction.

headline: Google’s best new camera feature is only for the Pixel 11 series
summary: Google introduces "Camera Looks" as a new Pixel 11 feature. It processes images to avoid the typical "smartphone" aesthetic. The "Digi" style mimics photos taken by older digital cameras.

headline: Today’s Top Deals: Best Buy’s MTG Sale, Nioh 3 for PS5, and GameSir G8+ Mobile Controller
summary: Discover top deals including Best Buy's MTG sale and Nioh 3 for PS5. Grab the GameSir G8+ Mobile Controller at a discount. Don't miss Barnes & Noble's book sale and Pokémon restocks.

headline: The Mandalorian and Grogu Lands Disney+ Release Date After Underperforming in Theaters With $345 Million
summary: 'The Mandalorian and Grogu' movie is coming to Disney+ in September. It underperformed in theaters, earning $345 million worldwide. Disney announced the streaming release after its theatrical run.

headline: As Avengers: Doomsday Tickets Go on Sale, Marvel Releases New Poster and Makes an Interesting Change to the YouTube Countdown
summary: 'Avengers: Doomsday' tickets are now on sale for fans. Marvel released a new poster to coincide with sales. A YouTube countdown also saw a subtle, significant change.

headline: 25 Years of Mafia Video Games: An Oral History
summary: IGN presents an oral history celebrating 25 years of Mafia video games. Developers share insights on the franchise's legacy. Explore the evolution and impact of the iconic series.

headline: Temporary ban on sale of disposable BBQs over wildfire risk
summary: A temporary ban on disposable BBQ sales has been imposed. The government cites significant wildfire risk due to drought and heatwave. Single-use grills are deemed a public safety hazard.

headline: Chris Mason: Where does this unorthodox by-election victory leave Nigel Farage?
summary: Nigel Farage secured an easy by-election victory in Clacton. However, the Reform UK leader was absent after the results. This raises questions about his political future and strategy.

headline: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
summary: Afghan women report their lives are unrecognizable after five years of Taliban rule. They face public floggings, job losses, and severe healthcare barriers. These conditions pose significant dangers to their lives.

headline: Britain's Finlay Tarling dies in Volta a Portugal accident
summary: British cyclist Finlay Tarling has tragically died. The 19-year-old was involved in a serious accident. The incident occurred during the eighth stage of the Volta a Portugal race.
